jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're a product-first team on a mission to help grow the cybersecurity culture 🔐
 
We want to instill cybersecurity good practices to employees in a way that's actually effective, and entertaining enough so that employees don't feel like they're working. Think Duolingo but for cybersecurity.
We created a platform to easily rollout a cybersecurity awareness program: the platform sends chat-based 4-minutes long courses to teams. Following the courses, the other side of the platform simulates phishing attacks, to prepare employees to face hackers — but in a safe environment.
 
Created in 2020, Riot has raised $45m with top-notch investors (Y Combinator, Base10, Funders Club and Frst Capital), and is now protecting more than 2,000,000 employees in over 2,000 companies (including Intercom, Deel and Deezer) all over the world.
 
Cybersecurity is everywhere. It's impacting everyone, everyday, and it's becoming the number one risk to any organization, whether it's a small business or a big firm. Yet, the cybersecurity culture in most companies is a disaster. Hackers are leveraging this by targeting the weakest link: the employees. We're on a mission to fix that.
 
You will join the product team. Your main focus will be to bring the alpha version of a product in the employee cybersecurity space into general availability.
 
 
The role
You will join the Product team as a Product Manager focused on Discovery, innovation and business impact. You will own your product end-to-end, exploring new opportunities, shaping strategy, and turning ideas into market-ready value.
We are not looking for an execution-driven PM, but for a product manager owner, innovator and strategist. Discovery and innovation are at the core of this role.

What you will do 🤝
- Product strategy, innovation & ownership : Own product vision, strategy and roadmap, explore new opportunities, shape bold product directions, and be accountable for business outcomes from discovery to market success.

- Discovery & innovation-driven product management (≈80%) : Lead a continuous discovery and innovation process: user interviews, trend and market exploration, hypothesis testing, prototyping and validation of new product concepts before delivery.

- Business mindset & go-to-market : Drive product decisions with a strong business lens, including monetization, pricing, positioning, sales enablement and go-to-market strategy to ensure adoption and revenue impact.

- Delivery collaboration (≈20%) : Translate validated discoveries into outcome-driven initiatives, collaborate closely with engineering and design, while relying on the Engineering Manager to own execution and delivery.
Who you are 🪪
- 2–10 years of experience in fast-paced, growth environments (not large, slow-moving organizations).

- Skills and impact matter more than formal Product Manager titles.

- Strong discovery instincts: you naturally engage with users and markets.

- Comfortable exploring ambiguity, proposing bold ideas, and shaping undefined problem spaces.

- Able to balance creativity, intuition and data in product decisions.

- Strong business mindset, with an interest in value creation and monetization.

- High ownership, autonomy and accountability.

- Motivated by Riot’s mission (cybersecurity expertise can be learned).

- Fluent in English, native French.

- Based in Paris or willing to relocate.
It will be a cultural fit if 🫂
- You're a doer: not afraid to get your hands dirty and get things done

- You have high standards: expect performance to be nothing short of the best

- You are an enthusiastic at heart: exhibit passion and excitement over work
Why join us at Riot 💜
- Join a financially-healthy company: we're financially strong and highly capital-efficient. Fundraising fuels our momentum, enabling us to scale faster and unlock new growth opportunities.

- Contribute to a fast-growing startup with a strong vision and high ambitions, backed by clear business goals. We've tripled our revenue over the past two years, and we plan to grow from €20M to €40M ARR in 2026.

- Experience the energy of a collaborative team in our modern and cosy office located in heart of Paris: République / Canal Saint-Martin
Recruitment process 🎙️
- First call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (30min)

- Second call with our Head of Product, who will be your manager (1hr)

- Onsite case study with our CTO and your future manager (1hr and half)

- Fit interview with our CEO (1hr)
At RIOT, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion fosters belonging. We are committed to building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
 
Please note that this is an on-site position with up to 2 days per month of remote work.
